design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5, 6]; the posting takes 5, the settlement (root) 6.
SCOPE SNAPSHOT: task 0 occupies the resumed-series chain (invalidation, course opening, consent form, booking) and its four tools. Task 1 claims vax_ext_missed_dose_posting (post_missed_dose_006fe732, agent) and vax_ext_dose_charge_settlement (settle_dose_charge_857cec2f, owner user, root); all six extended policies are covered and no tool is idle.
WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller only wants to pay for this morning's shot. The dose never posted, and the settlement waits on the dose standing on the history. Posting it means reading a messy zoster history: Kestrel's own dose 1, a plan-billed copy of it that the registry delivered two days late, a 2016 live-zoster record and an undocumented 2024 report, so the posted dose is dose 2 and not dose 5, 4 or 3. The charge is a six-factor computation across three other difficulties' records (Savings Club and its fee, the ended plan's termination date, prescription pickups and refills) plus a bundle method that applies only once the posted dose leaves the course with nothing still needed.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root vax_ext_dose_charge_settlement; one edge to vax_ext_missed_dose_posting, value_input, gate starting_price, state form, sentence 'The charge for a dose is settled only after the course history carries that dose as a given dose with its observation minutes recorded.' Four-point test: 'only after'; a record-visible state; no tool, id or code token; hard requirement. Exactly one write of this difficulty creates a dose-given entry for a Kestrel dose (the posting). False at the opening: today's appointment and form stand with no dose entry, and the course shows 1 dose still needed. Deletion sensitivity: without the posting the charge would be 179.39 instead of 151.45.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: both writes realise vax_dose_administered, governed by vax_agg_visit_and_season, vax_evt_billing (cash: the plan is terminated), and vax_evt_dose_administration: dose_on_open_course, consent_current (form signed 2026-09-24, day 0 of 7), dose2_interval (immunocompromised: 28 days, earliest 2026-07-16). Observation minutes follow the base rule itself (30 for a reported severe allergy). The settlement declares its overwrite of vax_evt_billing's cash-price sentence.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: the shingles course; the dose is the one given at today's 09:45 appointment; the payment attaches to the dose entry the posting returns. Kestrel's dose 1 was plan-billed, which selects the bundle-share method.
FACTOR CARD (posting, dose 2): numbering_basis (baseline every entry -> 5); copy_match_window 3 days (baseline no window -> 3; near-miss: the copy is dated 2 days after Kestrel's dose); copy_position_rule 0 (-> 3); undocumented_position_rule 0 (-> 3); live_zoster_records set aside the 2016 record (-> 3); whole baseline 5. FACTOR CARD (settlement, 151.45): series_bundle 206.991 (-> 169.39); savings_club 10% (-> 165.94); coverage_continuity 10% from the termination date 62 days ago (-> 165.94; near-miss: the closing date 59 days ago would give 20%); pharmacy_patient 5% (-> 159.73); reduction_ceiling 22% (-> 145.24); on_time_series 10.00 (-> 161.45; near-miss: the latest dose 1 entry is the outside copy); whole baseline 229.99. Cross-difficulty: copay, coverage, rx; multi-source: club, continuity, pharmacy-patient.
RULE <-> COMPUTE: every reading or branching binding quotes its rule sentences in compute_basis; the settlement's combination sentence pins the combination, base, order, cap moment and rounding moment; windows map to within_months; the posting's live-record cutoff recombinant_available_on maps to MONTHS(K('recombinant_available_on'), NOW).
SEED ROLES: customer, Brice Road store, terminated plan (termination vs closing date), Savings Club enrollment and fee, warfarin/epinephrine/tacrolimus prescriptions with three refills and three pickups, the course and its eleven ledger rows. The course's doses account reflects only Kestrel's dose 1 (registry imports never touch it). No automatic clause is pending.
PERSONA: polite retired librarian; volunteers the goal (pay for this morning's shot by card) and the situation (card machine down). Given only when asked: phone and DOB, email/ZIP, lot 4ZR8816C, store 04562, insurance ended in late July, Savings Club membership, a severe bee-sting allergy with an EpiPen, medicines, and her earlier shingles history (old vaccine in 2016, an undocumented 2024 mention). Passive: completes the handed-over payment and ends.
STANDARD SOLUTION AND RECOMPUTATION (the gate's own evaluator over the real tools): posting dose_number=2, observation 30; settlement patient_pay_usd=151.45.
REVISION ROUND 2 (policy-task audit F-12, T1-1..T1-3): (F-12/T1-1) the posting no longer computes observation minutes from ladders that are not immunization practice; observation follows the base rule, and the posting's computed quantity is the dose number the posted dose takes under record conventions (copy match window, copy and undocumented positions, live zoster records, numbering basis); its declared observation overwrite is removed. (T1-2) near-misses seeded: a registry copy dated two days after Kestrel's dose, a pre-recombinant 2016 record, an undocumented 2024 report, and a plan whose record-closing date (59 days) differs from its termination date (62 days). (T1-3) every factor_sensitivity.tier_taken is recomputed from the world. The settlement now reads completion from the course's doses still needed, judges dose 1 by the Kestrel entry, implements 'paid in cash at a Kestrel store', and its cap values bind in the reshaped world.
REVISION ROUND 3 (audit revision_2: N-1, N-2, N-3, N-4, T1-4, T1-5, T1-6): (T1-6) the posting call's observation_minutes is 30 again; a round-2 patch had written the computed dose number into it. (T1-5) today's appointment and form now print dose 3, the booking system's stale count, and the posting policy declares that a posted dose is covered by the form signed for its appointment whatever dose number it prints (overwrite of base consent_current), so the scored dose 2 is no longer stamped on any record. (N-1) the copy match window is 3 / 1 / 0 days (never 'no window'), so the copy-position fall-through ('one each') is reachable with a matched copy. (N-2/N-3/T1-4) where Kestrel gave no dose the number is also counted from positions (no copy matching), so the undocumented and live-zoster tiers for courses without a Kestrel dose reach the number; the undocumented ladder is now partitioned by a documented outside entry / Kestrel report. (N-4) the copy window reads the latest dose Kestrel gave at the course's store in both rule and compute; the settlement's on-time credit counts a dose 1 at the course's store for its first tier and requires that no Kestrel store gave dose 1 for its second. Re-run: posting dose 2 (baselines 5, 3, 3, 3, 3; whole 5), settlement 151.45 (unchanged figures).
REVISION ROUND 4 (audit revision_3: N-5 / T1-7 and observations): the posting's numbering_basis ladder is again count positions (Kestrel gave a dose and the history exceeds the account) / take the account / one past every dose entry (Kestrel gave none), and its fall-through is its declared baseline; the live-zoster ladder's second tier now applies to a Kestrel dose not yet reported to the registry, so every tier of the live-zoster, undocumented and copy ladders reaches the number through the positions tier. The posting's consent overwrite now also states the rule for a dose given and recorded at the visit itself ('for that dose'), so the replacement is as wide as the superseded clause. Re-run: posting dose 2 (baselines 5, 3, 3, 3, 3; whole 5), settlement 151.45; task 0 untouched.
user_scenario: You are Marguerite Tolliver, 57, a retired school librarian, polite and a little chatty, who likes to settle things the same day. This morning at 9:45 you had your second shingles shot at the Kestrel Brice Road store in Reynoldsburg, the one you booked by phone after you missed the August appointment. The card machine at the pharmacy counter was not working, so the pharmacist gave you your vaccination card and told you to call the Patient Care Desk and pay over the phone. You are calling to pay for this morning's shot now, by card, and you are happy for the representative to do whatever is needed on their side so that you can pay. You do not know what the shot costs and you do not suggest an amount. When asked who you are, you give your phone number, 2065550452, and your date of birth, November 23, 1968 (1968-11-23); only if they need more do you give your email, m.tolliver@corvidmail.net, or your ZIP code, 43068. If they ask for the lot number, you read it from the vaccination card the pharmacist gave you: 4ZR8816C. If they ask which store, it is Brice Road, store number 04562. If they ask about insurance, you say the plan from your old job ended in late July and the new one has not started, so you understand you are paying yourself; if they ask about the Kestrel Rx Savings Club, you say yes, you joined in March, and you read the member number 4SC0071852 only if they ask for it. If they ask about allergies or reactions, you say you have a severe bee-sting allergy and carry an EpiPen for it, and that after the first shingles shot the pharmacist kept you in the chair for half an hour. If they ask about earlier shingles shots, you say you had the old shingles vaccine back in 2016, and that in 2024 you mentioned a shingles shot to a nurse at a health fair but have no paperwork for it; the June shot at Brice Road was your first of the new two-shot series. If they ask about your medicines, you say you are a kidney transplant patient on tacrolimus and you also take warfarin. You never mention how long they watched you this morning unless asked, and then you only say it felt like a long while. When the representative tells you the amount and hands the payment over to you, you complete the payment yourself and tell them it went through. When you hear the payment is recorded, you thank them and end the call; you do not ask for a receipt or anything else.

factor_trace: numbering_basis (method): 4 dose entries against required 2 less 1 still needed = 1 accounted, and Kestrel gave dose 1 at Brice Road: count positions with matched copies, undocumented entries and live zoster records set aside; baseline (the fall-through tier, one past every dose entry) counts 4 and gives dose 5.

copy_match_window (parameter): Kestrel reported dose 1 (2026-06-23), so the window is copy_match_days_reported = 3; the plan-billed outside entry of 2026-06-24 is 2 days after Kestrel's 2026-06-22 dose at the course's store and is matched; baseline same-day window (copy_match_days_other = 0) misses it and gives dose 3.
copy_position_rule (parameter): Kestrel reported a dose, so the matched copy holds copy_positions_reported = 0; baseline lets it hold one and gives dose 3.

undocumented_position_rule (parameter): a documented cash-paid outside entry (the 2016 record, lot 4ZV0332A) is on the course, so the undocumented 2024 report holds unlotted_positions_with_documented = 0; baseline lets it hold one and gives dose 3.

live_zoster_records (method): a recombinant zoster course whose Kestrel dose is reported to the registry (2026-06-23): the 2016-04-11 entry (before 2017-10-20) is set aside; baseline sets nothing aside and gives dose 3.

plain: positions 4 - 1 - 1 - 1 = 1; result 2. Near-misses: the copy dated two days after Kestrel's dose, the pre-recombinant 2016 record, the undocumented 2024 report, and the dose 3 printed on today's appointment and form (stale stamp).

savings_club (parameter, cross-difficulty copay, multi-source): Savings Club Individual active, vaccine discount 10, fee 2026-03-10 within 12 months: 10%; baseline 0 gives 165.94.

coverage_continuity (parameter, cross-difficulty coverage, multi-source): termination date 2026-07-24, 62 days ago (> 60), dose 1 billed to the plan: 10%; baseline 0 gives 165.94. Near-miss: the record's closing date 2026-07-27 (59 days) would wrongly give 20%.
pharmacy_patient (parameter, cross-difficulty rx, multi-source): 3 pickups and 3 refills in 3 months: 5%; baseline 0 (cap then 18%) gives 159.73.
reduction_ceiling (parameter, cross-difficulty copay): fee in 12 months and the pharmacy-patient reduction applies: cap 22%; baseline no cap (25%) gives 145.24.

on_time_series (parameter): dose 2 94 days after the dose 1 Kestrel gave at Brice Road (<= 180): 10.00; baseline 0 gives 161.45. Near-miss: the latest dose 1 entry is the 2026-06-24 copy from another provider, which would wrongly select the 5.00 tier.
